snippet.title: Ski Yeet   Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
SKI YEET — Official Gameplay Trailer
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4798170/Ski_Yeet/

The mountain never ends. Neither do the Cryptids!

Ski Yeet is a fast, frosty roguelike that takes the classic thrill and wraps it around an endless cylindrical mountain. Carve your way down, grab power-ups, dodge the trees and rocks — and whatever you do, don't let the Cryptids catch up. Every run is different, every run gets faster, and every run ends the same way unless you're good enough to keep ahead!

🎿 What's in the game:

- An endless, wrapping mountain that never lets you settle.
- Roguelike runs, fresh hazards and routes every time.
- Tiered power-ups that stack and escalate as you descend.
- Relentless Cryptids that learns to hunt you down.
- Tight, twitchy controls built for "just one more run".
